emails.subject: Thanks for the January gallery stroll
emails.body: Thanks for walking Canyon Road with me yesterday. I enjoyed the quiet afternoon and got home with the postcard set tucked safely in my bag. Nothing else needed from my side.

emails.subject: Book swap tea was lovely
emails.body: Thank you for hosting the poetry swap. I left the borrowed spoon on your porch shelf this morning, and I do not need any books back.
